book.name: SAN LUCAS
book.title: An alhua’ cau thuchath c’al an t’ocat inic Lucas

content: A Jesús ani a Zaqueo
Taley otsits a Jesús ti bichou Jericó ani tats ti xe’ets.
Ani taja’ c’uajat jun i rico inic im bij Zaqueo. Pel i oc’lec c’al am bats’c’ul jalbixtalab tumin c’al an gobierno.
In aychal quin tsu’u a Jesús, in le’ quin exla’. Tocat yab in ejtohual quin alhua’ tsu’u tin ebal an mulcunel ani cum jaye tsipilin jaja’ ti inic.
Jaxtam oc’chith c’ale athithil jun ti ne’ets ca huat’ey a Jesús, ani c’athiy al jun i te’ sicómoro abal quin alhua’ tsu’u.
Tam tim baju a Jesús ba’ al nixe’ xi te’, tam in tsu’u c’uajat a Zaqueo hualq’ui’. Tam in ucha’: ―Thubat quit pa’iy Zaqueo, cum nan ne’ets xo’ quin jilc’on ta q’uima’.
Tam thubat pa’iy lej culbel, c’ale quim bats’u a Jesús tin q’uima’.
Tam tin ats’a’chic axi muthat taja’ antsana’ in ulu a Jesús, tam in c’uiyath ulu abal jale’ ne’ets ca jilc’on tin q’uima’ i hualbith inic.

Tam cubiy a Zaqueo tin tamet jaja’chic, ani in ucha’a Jesús: ―Ajatic, xo’ nan ne’ets cu ts’ejhualiy c’al an ts’ejhuantalchic ma tam ts’ejel jahua’ u cua’al. Max u c’ambith tixc’anchamal jita’ an tumin ne’ets cu huichbanchi ma tse’ huichc’oth.
A Jesús toc’tsin: ―Ma xohue’ jec’onthachits axe’ xi inic axi pel in at xits’al a Abraham. Jaye ne’ets ca jec’onthachic axi tin q’uima’.
Nana’ tin Juntal patal an inicchic in che’nec cu aliy axi xe’ets q’uibenec al an hualabtalab ani cu jec’ontha’.
An jalpith cau c’al an tuminchic

Hue’ ne’ets ca ulitschic ti Jerusalén a Jesús ani axi ts’at’atchic c’al jaja’ in ats’anchal in cahuintal, c’al in tsalpayalchic abal hualam hue’its a Dios ne’ets quin t’aja’ ti lej Ts’ale teje’ tsabal. Tam olchinal i jalpith cau c’al a Jesús.
In ulu antse’: ―Jun i inic axi lej bijithits quim baju ti ts’ale ne’ets ca c’ale al jun i bichou ou abal ca punuhuat tihua’ ti ts’ale, ani talbel ne’ets ca huichiy tim bichou.
Oc’ox in caniy ca chich c’al jaja’ lajuj in t’ojnalil, ani im pitha’ ti junchic jun i tumin axi lej yan in jalbil. In ucha’chic quin t’ojonthanchi ma tam ta ca huichits jaja’cua’.
Ani cum at’ab jaja’ c’al am bichou jun ti ne’ets ca punuhuat, chich i abathualechic quin ucha’ an oc’lec ts’ale abal yab u le’nab ti ts’ale nixe’ axi lej bijithits.

Aba ani’ yab u le’nab, bel c’ale ani punuhuat ti ts’ale. Taley talbel huichiy tim bichou. Ulits ani in aba’ ca caniyat ca chich ti junchic ax im pithamal an tumin ca t’ojonthanchat, cum in le’ quin exla’ jay in atamal.
Uchan c’al axi oc’ox chich: Pay’lom, c’al an tumin ax tim pithamal u atamal lajuj huichc’oth.
Ani toc’tsin an ts’ale: Pel it lej alhua’ t’ojnal cum antsana’ tin alhua’ t’ojonthanchamal axi hue’ an tumin ax tu pithamal. Jaxtam nan ne’ets tu punu tit oc’lec c’al lajuj i bichou.
Chich q’ue’at i t’ojnal in ucha’ an ts’ale: Pay’lom, c’al an tumin ax tim pithamal u atamal bo’ huichc’oth.
Ani toc’tsin an ts’ale: Nan ne’ets tu punu tit oc’lec c’al bo’ i bichou.
Tamna’ chich q’ue’ate an t’ojnal in ucha’ an ts’ale: Pay’lom, te tu huichbanchal an tumin ax tim pithamal. Tu alhua’ beletnanchi thut’pipith c’al i toltom.
Cum it lej pathay, u ts’ejnal max yab cu ejtou tu alhua’ t’ojonthanchi a tuminal. U tso’ob abal a tixc’anchal jat’hua’ tim patal an tumin axi it huichc’oth t’ojonthanchithits.

Tam uchan an t’ojnal: Tata’ ojni’ c’al jahua’ tin uchamal nan tu exlalits abal pel it pojcax inic. Tin exlal abal im pathaycua’ ani u t’ixc’anchal jat’hua’ tim patal an tumin ax in huichc’oth t’ojonthanchithitscua’.
¿Max antsana’ u ey tin tsalpanchal, jale’ yab tim binanchi u tuminal c’al q’ue’at i inic abal jaja’ tiquin t’ojonthanchi ani cu bats’unchi in oc’tal u tuminal?
Tam an ts’ale in ucha’ axi c’uajat taja’chic: Ca tixc’anchi axe’ xi inic an tumin ani ca huat’banchi ax tin t’ojonthanchamalits lajuj huichc’oth.
Toc’tsinchic: Pay’lom, ca tsu’u abal in cua’alits lajuj i tumin.

Toc’tsin an ts’ale: Nan tu uchalchic abal jitats quin alhua’ t’ojonthanchi jahua’ u pithamal nan ne’ets cu pithaye más, ani jitats yab quin alhua’ t’ojonthanchi ne’ets cu tixc’anchi axi hue’ u pithamal.
Ani axi tomolnaxchic yab tin le’na’ tin ts’ale, ca chi’tha’ teje’ tu tamet ani tiquin tsemthanchi.
U otsel a Jesús ti Jerusalén
Tam ti talits quin ulu antsana’ a Jesús, ta c’ale in aynal am bel ti Jerusalén.
Hue’its quim baju am bichou Betfagé ani am bichou Betania axi utatchic ti bolchal Olivos, ani ma taja’ a Jesús ne’ets quin aba’ tsab in exobalil c’al i cau.
In ucha’chic: ―Quit c’alechic al nixe’ xi bichou axi utatits, ani taja’ ne’ets ca ela’ jun i burro huic’at axi lejat yabaye punume. Ca piliy ani tiquin chanchi teje’.
Max jita’ ti ucha’ abal jale’ ta piliyal, ca ucha’ abal nana’ in Ajatic ax u yejenchal.
Tana’ c’alechic ani in ela’ am burro jant’ini’ ti uchnenec c’al a Jesús ne’ets quin ela’.
Tam tim piliyalits am burro, tam tu conoyab c’al an thabal: ―¿Jale’ ta piliyal am burro?
Toc’tsin jaja’chic: ―Cum an Ajatic in yejenchal.
Tam in chi’tha’chic am burro c’al a Jesús. Im punchal jaja’chic in toltomil tin cux am burro, ani tam puney a Jesús.
Ani an mulcunel in mo’cal in toltomil ba’ am bel jun ti ne’ets ca huat’ey a Jesús.

Tam ti utatits ne’ets quim baju am bel axi pa’a’al ti bolchal Olivos, patal am belomchic axi ts’at’at c’al a Jesús in ts’i’quiyal ti thajat cau c’al in ichich lej culbelchic. Im puhuethanchal im bij a Dios, cum in tsu’umalits yan i labith t’ajbilab ax in t’ajamal a Jesús.
In thajat ulalchic: ―Qui ajatnanchi im bij i Ts’alejil axi te talits abath c’al a Dios. Qui puhuethanchi im bij a t’ec’at Dios ti eb axi jun ejetbethanchix c’al i ichich.
Tam uchan a Jesús c’al talchic i fariseochic axi al an mulcunel: ―Exobchix, ca ucha’ ca ts’ibc’an an mulcunel.
A Jesús in toc’tsiychic: ―Nan tu uchalchic max ca ts’ibc’an an mulcunel, ma nixe’ xi t’ujubchic mo’ol ne’ets quin thajat puhuethanchi im bij a Dios.
Tam ti utatits ne’ets ca ulits ti Jerusalén, a Jesús in met’a’ am bichou ani in uc’nanchal.
In ulu: ―Lej alhua’ max xo’ a tso’obnalaquitschic jant’ini’ quit jec’ontha ani quit c’uajiy jun ejet ta bichou. Expith ejtil it joc’tsiye.
Ne’ets quim baju a q’uichachic lej c’ac’ath tam a tomolnaxilchic ne’ets ti tala’ t’oc’banchi a bichou ti peiéx, ani ma ni hue’ yab ne’ets ca ejtouchic quit pit’c’on.

Ne’ets ti tala’ paclunchi a bichou ani ne’ets ti tsemtha’chic. Ni jun i t’ujub ne’ets ca jilc’on t’i’póx. Antsana’ ne’ets quit t’ajchinchic, cum yab a tso’obnal abal nan xo’ in abath c’al a Dios abal tu jec’onthalac.
A Jesús in quethmayal eleb i inicchic axi al am pulic tiyopan
Taley otsits a Jesús ti al am pulic tiyopan ti Jerusalén, in tala’ quethmachiquiyal eleb axi nujul ani axi ts’a’um taja’.

In ucha’chic: ―Thuchathits ti al an T’ocat Thuchlab jahua’ in ulu a Dios antse’: U q’uima’ ja’its jun ta ca olon an inicchiccua’. Nan tu uchalchic abal xo’ tata’ a eyenthal abal ca cue’chi jant’o ax u che’el ti ol.

Chuthel chuthel exome ti exobchix a Jesús taja’ ti al am pulic tiyopan, ani an oc’lec pale’chic ani an exobchix c’al an ts’ejcath cau binath c’al a Moisés ani an oc’lecchic ti al am bichou in junax lubal quin aliy jant’ini’ ti quin tsemtha’ a Jesús.
Tocat yab in elalchic jant’ini’, cum patal am bichou in lej canat ats’anchal jahua’ in exobchal a Jesús.
